paragraphs: Info Page
All cannabis businesses must tell us how they will run some of their operations.
We will ask you for the following information on the general business operations form of the cannabis business application.

sections.heading: Using renewable energy
paragraphs: All cannabis businesses must fulfill our renewable energy mandate. We will ask if you will:
Take part in CleanPowerSF's Green Service
Use Hetch Hetchy hydroelectric power supply through SF Public Utility Commission
Generate renewable energy onsite
The Department of the Environment or the Public Utilities Commission will look at how much energy your business uses in the first year.

sections.heading: Securing cannabis waste
paragraphs: Your waste must be locked away from the public.
Recology is the only waste management company for San Francisco. Your business must use Recology to handle waste.
Recology is able to pick up your waste from an additional locked area, if you pay them an extra fee. We will ask you if you will be using this service.

sections.heading: Receiving shipments
paragraphs: We will ask how you will log cannabis as it enters your business, including:
When and where you will receive your shipments
How you will unload your shipments
Who receives the shipments
How you will record the shipments
How you will ensure staff and public safety
How you will prevent theft
If your storefront retail business does not have a loading area in the back, contact the Office of Cannabis for more information.

sections.heading: Keeping track of your products
paragraphs: We will ask how you will log your products, including:
How you will record cannabis products moved to and from inventory
How and how often you will do inventory reconciliation
All cannabis businesses must set up track and trace . You must contact the Office of Cannabis within 24 hours if there is more than 5% difference between your inventory logs and track and trace.
You must have an onsite employee overseeing your track and trace program. We will ask you for their name and phone number.

sections.heading: Logging hazardous materials
paragraphs: You will need to tell us about hazardous materials you plan on using, if you are a:
Cultivator
Manufacturer
Testing laboratory
If you are, we will ask if you will have at your business:
Isopropyl alcohol or isopropanol
Acetone
Ethanol
Propane
Butane
Carbon dioxide
Bleach
Consumer-grade household cleaners
Chemicals for soil, such as nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, calcium, magnesium, sulfur
Plant nutrients, such as boron, chlorine, copper, iron, manganese, zinc, molybdenum
Pesticides
Herbicides
Fungicides
Rodenticides
We will ask you how you plan on storing those materials safely. For example, if there is an earthquake.
We will ask you for more details about fertilizers and pesticides if you are a cultivator.

sections.heading: Handling cannabis
paragraphs: We will ask how you will check batches going in and out of storage, including:
Product name
Company license
Storage date
ID
Batch number
Amounts
Expiration date
You will need to tell us how you will check labels for products you put up for sale, if you are a:
Storefront retailer
Delivery only retailer
Distributor
Cultivator
Manufacturer
If you are, checking labels may include the products’:
Weight
Source
Cultivation and packaging date
Cannabis type
Unique ID
We will ask how you will prevent cannabis products from going bad , including:
Pest control
Temperature control
Maintenance
Cleaning
We will ask how your business will handle returns, including:
How you will log returns into the track and trace system
What will happen to the product

sections.heading: Transporting cannabis
paragraphs: You need to tell us how you will move cannabis from your business to another cannabis business, if you are a:
Distributor
Retail business with multiple locations
If you are, we will ask you:
How you will prevent your cannabis products from going bad when you transport them (temperature control, maintenance, cleaning)
If you will hire drivers in house or contract out for transportation services
If you will hire drivers in house, we will ask:
What kinds of cannabis businesses you will be transporting cannabis to
If you will transport cannabis within San Francisco, the wider Bay Area, or elsewhere in the state
If your cannabis products will be on the road overnight
How cannabis will be stored in the vehicle (security and identification)
If you will contract out for transportation services, we will ask for:
The services you are contracting out for
Contracting company name
Full name of contact at the company
Phone number of contact
Copy of contract
